verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's 'flex' service tier is explicitly marketed for 'non-production or lower-priority tasks such as model evaluations, data enrichment, and asynchronous workloads,' implying suitability for large batch-style jobs, but there is no documented batch/bulk API (e.g., file-based batch endpoint, job queue, or multi-item submission mechanism) comparable to OpenAI's Batch API. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoint or job-submission API, evidence of processing many items in a single call, any docs on batch size limits or bulk pricing.
